name: Diane Arbus: Konstellationen at Gropius Bau
description: A major retrospective of iconic American photographer Diane Arbus opens at the Gropius Bau as part of Berlin Art Week 2026. Arbus's unflinching portraits of marginalized subjects redefined photographic portraiture in the 1960s and 70s, and her legacy continues to provoke urgent conversations about representation, empathy and the gaze.
